name: quantlab
description: QuantLab - visual no-code trading strategy backtesting platform

scripts.postinstall: npm run build -w packages/shared-types && npm run build -w packages/domain
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared-types && npm run build -w packages/domain && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
